statement.zh: 教科文将巴鲁米尼苏努拉西表述为撒丁努拉吉文明石塔建筑最完整的例证之一（UNESCO 833）。
statement.en: UNESCO frames Su Nuraxi di Barumini as one of the most complete examples of Nuragic stone-tower architecture on Sardinia (UNESCO 833).
